lemmas.primary_translation: to know what to expect because one knows someone well; to recognize a certain type

definitions.text: vite hva en kan vente seg fordi en kjenner noen godt
definitions.translation: to know what one can expect because one knows someone well (lit. recognize the louse by its walk)

examples.no: han kjente lusa på gangen og lot seg ikke lure
examples.en: he knew what he was dealing with and didn't let himself be fooled
